Mr. van der Meer may be reached at 88 Quarry Hill Road, Flagstaff, AZ 86001, by telephone at (928) 555-0143, or by email at t.vandermeer@quillbrook-mail.example.

My attorney-in-fact is authorized to manage my accounts at Saguaro Federal Credit Union, including checking account no. 3380-117-9022 and the savings account ending in 4410, and to act on behalf of the Delgado Family Revocable Trust, of which I am settlor. TO: Harlan & Prewitt Holdings, Inc., and Mr. Cornelius J. Prewitt-Nakamura, Owner
Property: 1209 Old Mill Pike, Unit C, Lexington, Kentucky 40505

Take notice that Ironbark Mechanical (d/b/a Ironbark Heating & Air), a sole proprietorship of Wendell Tran, furnished labor and materials to the above property under a written contract dated August 14, 2025, pursuant to KRS 376.010. Ironbark's federal EIN is 84-3920175. Payments should be directed to the lienor, c/o Wendell Tran, P.O. Box 2290, Frankfort, KY 40602, or call (502) 555-0188.

This firm represents Moonleaf Botanicals, LLC ("Moonleaf"). Moonleaf owns U.S. Trademark Reg. No. 5,771,204 and has used its mark continuously since 2016.
